description.value:
Krogan biology is designed to keep functioning long after other species would be dead. Their distributed circulatory and nervous systems, multi-chambered hearts, and accelerated cellular repair make them extraordinarily difficult to bring down through conventional injury. Wounds that would cripple a human or turian are inconveniences to a krogan with time to breathe.

You gain fast healing 1: at the start of each of your turns, if you are below half your maximum Hit Points, you recover 1 Hit Point. This healing does not function if you are at 0 HP.
